ContextMenu_ER_OpenMonitor: 打开实时仓储与据点面板
ContextMenu_ER_NewSettlementEditor: 新建据点 (开启左键拖框划区)...
ContextMenu_ER_EditSettlementFmt: 编辑据点划区 [%1] (左键拖框增删)...
ContextMenu_ER_MarkPrivateFmt: 设为私密容器 (排除公共仓): %1
ContextMenu_ER_UnmarkPrivateFmt: 恢复公共容器 (纳入据点仓): %1
ContextMenu_ER_M2_SpawnTest: 在此生成测试 NPC (含背包/装备原件)
ContextMenu_ER_M3_SitHereFmt: 令最近 NPC 坐这里 [%1]
ContextMenu_ER_M3_SleepBedFmt: 令最近 NPC 睡这张床 [%1]
ContextMenu_ER_M3_SetBrainSettlementFmt: 大脑切换为据点自治 (同时停随) [%1]
ContextMenu_ER_M3_AssignCurSettlementFmt: 指派到当前据点 [%1] 并切据点大脑 [%2]
ContextMenu_ER_M3_AssignSettlementSubFmt: 指派所属据点并切据点大脑 [%1]
ContextMenu_ER_M3_SmartZoneMenuFmt: 容器物流角色与智能分区 [%1 | %2]
ContextMenu_ER_M3_Role_BUFFER_IN: 设为卸货缓冲箱 (BUFFER_IN 自动理货)
ContextMenu_ER_OpenContainerWizard: 配置容器分拣规则向导...
